Ubiquiti UniFi U6-Lite – High-Performance WiFi 6 Access Point

Compact, ceiling-mounted WiFi 6 AP with 4 spatial streams that improves upon the U6 Lite with higher performance and dual-band WiFi 6 support. Ideal for small and medium-sized businesses.

The Ubiquiti UniFi U6-Lite is a compact, powerful WiFi 6 (802.11ax) access point designed for high-speed, reliable wireless networking. Ideal for small to medium-sized businesses, offices, homes, and enterprises, the U6-Lite delivers dual-band connectivity with MU-MIMO and OFDMA technology, ensuring seamless performance even in high-density environments.

Key Features:

  • Next-Gen WiFi 6 Performance – Faster speeds, improved efficiency, and lower latency
  • Dual-Band Connectivity – Up to 1.5 Gbps combined speed (2.4GHz: 300 Mbps, 5GHz: 1200 Mbps)
  • Scalable UniFi Network Integration – Managed with the UniFi Network Application
  • Compact & Sleek Design – Easily mounts on ceilings or walls for minimal visual impact
  • PoE Support – Powered via 802.3af PoE, simplifying installation without extra cables


Upgrade your wireless network with the UniFi U6-Lite and experience fast, secure, and seamless connectivity for all your devices.
